out_of_schema_notes: Master plan spans the whole train; entities are the Step 3-10 process steps and the CQA framework.
The per-unit-operation plan register and the common statistical approach are reported via report_sections.

inventory.rationale: Title block declares document class 'Process Characterization Master Plan'.

process_steps.description: Forms the glycan, charge-variant and aggregate CQAs (design-space step)
Primary recovery and clarification; forms no product-quality CQA
Capture; sets leached Protein A; principal HCP and DNA clearance
Low-pH hold; sets the cumulative XMuLV (enveloped) clearance
Polish; principal aggregate reduction; major HCP/DNA/leached-PA clearance
Flow-through polish; sets the cumulative MVM clearance; clears XMuLV/HCP/DNA
Dedicated small-virus removal; principal MVM clearance
Formulation / mass balance; delivers drug substance at target concentration

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 is the umbrella plan governing the Stage 1 process characterization of the A-Mab drug-substance process.
The characterization covers 37 process parameters against 10 drug-substance CQAs on qualified scale-down models.
The study scope and study-type assignment are set by the Pre-Characterization Process Risk Assessment (RA-001).

source_references.quote: set by the Pre-Characterization Process Risk Assessment

statements.statement_text: The response-surface model is the predictive / design-space model.
The master plan governs the eight per-unit-operation Process Characterization Plans.
The per-unit-operation reports are consolidated in the Process Characterization Master Report (PCMR-001).

source_references.quote: consolidated in the Process Characterization Master Report
